# AdsWise Marketing

> AdsWise Marketing is a strategy-first digital marketing agency based in Thergaon, Pune, Maharashtra, India, founded by Gaurav Jagtap (Founder & CEO). It builds measurable marketing systems — SEO, performance marketing, social media, branding, websites and lead generation — for businesses across India.

- Website: https://www.adswisemarketing.com
- Founder & CEO: Gaurav Jagtap — https://www.adswisemarketing.com/gauravjagtap-about
- Email: office@adswisemarketing.com
- Phone: +91 9730266648
- Location: Thergaon, Pune 411033, Maharashtra, India
- Areas served: Pune, Maharashtra and all of India
